description: An MCP tool call that carries a credential in any of its arguments (the token shapes of the privacy check: GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, Slack, Google, Stripe, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face tokens, private keys) asks with its reason (Knostic, 'When an MCP tool asks for your GitHub token', 2026-11; gadgethumans-mcp, 2026-09).

mcp.reason: a credential in the arguments of an MCP tool: a server gets to keep and use what it is given
